spec_text.FR-007: Define arithmetic_alu as a class derived from base_alu and support the listed arithmetic operations.
spec_text.OP-004: result = A + B; carry = unsigned carry out
spec_text.OP-005: result = A + B + carry; carry = unsigned carry out
spec_text.OP-006: result = A - B; carry = borrow out
spec_text.OP-007: result = A - B - carry; carry = borrow out
spec_text.D-005: Add a bit carry property to arithmetic_alu (status flag, like a CPU carry flag). ADDC computes A + B + carry. ADD, ADDC, SUB, SUBB all update carry with the unsigned carry/borrow out. Calc's signature stays as in the spec.
spec_text.D-006: The same carry bit acts as borrow. SUBB computes A - B - carry. Borrow out = 1 when the unsigned subtraction needs a borrow.
spec_text.D-016: Expose only the carry flag (D-005), read with function bit get_carry(). No overflow flag.
spec_text.D-002: in1/operand_A is the first operand, in2/operand_B the second. Binary ops compute A op B; SUB is A - B. Port-B ops (SEL_B, INC_B, DEC_B) use operand_B only.
spec_text.D-004: Resolved by the language: the spec declares int, which is 32-bit, signed, 2-state in SystemVerilog. Arithmetic wraps modulo 2^32. Shift right is logical (>>), rotates work on 32 bits.
spec_text.D-007: initialize() sets operand_A = 0, operand_B = 0, alu_op = OP_SEL_B, alu_result = 0 (and carry = 0 in arithmetic_alu). new() calls initialize().
spec_text.D-010: display() prints one line: [<class>] op=<op.name()> A=<%0d> B=<%0d> result=<%0d> (arithmetic_alu adds  carry=<0/1>).
